_doc: Constrained-primitive grammar. Each detected copper object is tested against these rules top-to-bottom; the FIRST match decides which CAD tool builds it and how its parameters are snapped/adjusted. This externalises the shape->tool->adjustment mapping that used to be hard-coded.

rules.name: shield_ring
rules.comment: mounting pads are HOLLOW rings (copper in the hatched band only); the region carries an inner hole
